f3-site-lock.claim: Canonical site-state lock: ownership, readiness, construction, damage and clutter per window

jacar-ormoc-customs.claim: A customs building with a fixed red light stood at Ormoc port (Notice to Mariners); its appearance and 1944 survival are not sourced, and the light is excluded (F3 section 8)

f3-ormoc-actions.claim: Ormoc was the destination of Japanese reinforcement convoys (the 11 Nov strike on the Ormoc convoy and the 3 Dec destroyer action in Ormoc Bay)

reference.source: No runway: a port. The frame is the shipped terrain's Ormoc shore, fitted by tools/sites/localMap.ts 2026-10-17: center (-75727,-22748), heading 110 so local +x points seaward (south-southwest) and local z runs along the shore; the shore lies at local x about +45. The DEM places the port about 0.8 km east of where Ormoc City stands, so the position is the terrain's coast, not a survey. Every building pose is invented gameplay layout unless its basis says otherwise.

pre-invasion.note: Japanese port and logistics hub, intact (F3 section 5, 18-19 Oct).
